_comment: Golden taxonomy for F1's ticket-category module. Exactly the 7 categories named in the mission goal string verbatim ('every ticket category created (admission, exhibitor, workshops, field trips, SAOC Symposium, WOSA Conference, cocktail/reception)'). purchaseSurface maps each fine-grained category to the EXISTING 3-value Sanity ticketType.category enum (admission | conference | workshop-field-trip) that already gates which public page a document appears on -- this is a NEW, more granular layer ABOVE that enum, not a replacement of it. 'unresolved-nos-boundary' is a real, explicit value (not a silent default) for the one category whose purchase surface this mission is not authorized to decide -- see README.md 'Exhibitor entry: deliberately unresolved'.
